# `drt plan` coverage by destination

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_plan_coverage.py from drt/engine/plan_coverage.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

`drt plan` / `drt apply` need to know what a destination currently holds. Where that is not possible, `drt plan` exits 1 with a reason and writes no file ([When a plan is unavailable](plan.md#when-a-plan-is-unavailable)). This page is generated from the per-destination declaration in `drt/engine/plan_coverage.py`; a test keeps each declaration in line with the code, and CI fails when a built-in destination has none.

## Planned (true create / update / delete change set)

`clickhouse`, `databricks`, `mysql`, `postgres`, `snowflake`

## Partly planned

| Destination | Why |
|---|---|
| `bigquery` | Only `mode: insert` (append-only) can be planned. `merge`, mirror and replace need a target read that BigQuery does not implement yet. |

## Not planned — no target state to diff

| Destination | Why |
|---|---|
| `amplitude` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `azure_blob` | Writes whole files or objects; there are no keyed target rows to diff. |
| `discord` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `email_smtp` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `file` | Writes whole files or objects; there are no keyed target rows to diff. |
| `gcs` | Writes whole files or objects; there are no keyed target rows to diff. |
| `github_actions` | Triggers a workflow run; Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `google_ads` | Conversion upload: Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `kafka` | Topic: Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `klaviyo` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `meta_conversions` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `mixpanel` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `parquet` | Writes whole files or objects; there are no keyed target rows to diff. |
| `rest_api` | Generic HTTP endpoint: drt has no read-back contract for it. |
| `s3` | Writes whole files or objects; there are no keyed target rows to diff. |
| `sendgrid` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `slack` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `sqs` | Queue: Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `staged_upload` | Staged file upload: Writes whole files or objects; there are no keyed target rows to diff. |
| `teams` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |
| `twilio` | Event/message sink: there is no stored target state to diff. |

Every plan also needs `destination.upsert_key` and a sync a plan can represent; see [When a plan is unavailable](plan.md#when-a-plan-is-unavailable). A third-party (plugin) destination needs no entry and is not listed here; whether it can be planned depends on what it implements.
